title: Modified wave operators are unbounded on $L^p$ for $p\neq 2$
summary: We study the $L^p$-boundedness of Isozaki--Kitada type modified wave operators associated with Schrödinger operators $P=-\partial_x^2 + V$ in one dimension for potentials $V$ including long-range potentials such as negative Coulomb-like ones $V(x) = -(1+|x|^2)^{-μ/2}$ for $μ>0$. For such potentials, if $ μ\in (1, 2)$, we prove that the middle and the high energy parts are bounded on $L^p (\mathbb{R})$ for any $p \in [1, \infty]$ but the low energy part is unbounded except for $p=2$.
